# The Shadium

> The Shadium finds the shaded seats at sports venues. Pick a stadium and a game, and it shows which sections and seats will be in sun or shade at that game's real first-pitch time.

The Shadium calculates shade from the sun's position (NOAA Solar Calculator), each venue's verified orientation and per-section geometry, cloud-cover weather from Open-Meteo, and official MLB schedule data. See the full methodology, including accuracy and limitations, at https://theshadium.com/how-it-works.

## Coverage

- 182 venues across three leagues: 30 MLB ballparks, 120 Minor League Baseball (MiLB) parks, and 32 NFL stadiums.
- Every venue has an "answer-first" summary of where the shaded seats are, a section-by-section shade table (Covered / partial back-rows / Exposed), seasonal patterns, and an orientation-aware FAQ.

## URL patterns

- Venue guide: https://theshadium.com/stadium/{id} — e.g. /stadium/yankees, /stadium/dodgers, /stadium/durham-bulls
- League index: https://theshadium.com/league/{league} — /league/mlb, /league/milb, /league/nfl
- All stadiums index: https://theshadium.com/stadiums
- Methodology: https://theshadium.com/how-it-works
- Blog: https://theshadium.com/blog

## Notes

- The Shadium is an independent tool and is not affiliated with MLB, MiLB, the NFL, or any team.
- Shade predictions are strong guides, not guarantees; real bowls curve, rows vary, and weather changes.
